preprocessing.description: model.preprocessing.preprocess_image (production inference path): load_img RGB resized to 224x224, then efficientnet.preprocess_input (expects raw 0-255 RGB arrays)

production_decision.description: The deployed model outputs a softmax probability for each of NORMAL, PNEUMONIA, COVID and predicts the class with the highest probability. No probability threshold is applied.

test.source: dataset/test (held out; never used for training or threshold selection)

validation.source: dataset/train validation_split=0.2, seed=42 (same hold-out as train_model.py)

binary_task.description: Secondary analysis of NORMAL vs PNEUMONIA only. Images labelled COVID are excluded (they appear in the three-class evaluation). Among the included images, an argmax prediction of COVID counts as 'not pneumonia'.

threshold_selection.method: Maximise Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) on validation, grid 0.01-0.99
threshold_selection.production_rule: argmax (no probability threshold is applied in production)

operating_points.label: Argmax (production rule)
operating_points.decision_rule: Pneumonia if PNEUMONIA has the highest of the 3 softmax probabilities; a NORMAL or COVID argmax counts as not pneumonia

operating_points.label: Validation-selected threshold (0.59) — analysis only
operating_points.decision_rule: Pneumonia if P(PNEUMONIA) >= 0.59 (Youden's J on validation). Not used in production

threshold_sweep.note: Descriptive trade-off only; no threshold was chosen from this sweep.

roc_auc_ovr.method: One-vs-rest: for each class, P(class) scores that class against the other two. Macro = unweighted mean over classes; weighted = mean weighted by class support.

strengths: Three-class accuracy is 89.4% on 987 held-out test images using the production argmax rule.
Macro one-vs-rest ROC-AUC 0.988: the softmax probabilities rank each class above the others well, even where argmax mislabels some images.
limitations: NORMAL recall is only 60.7%: 92 of 234 NORMAL images were assigned another class.
Most common error: 92 of 234 NORMAL images predicted as PNEUMONIA.

Production inference resizes images with nearest-neighbour interpolation (keras load_img), while training used bilinear resizing. This evaluation uses the production path, so it reflects what users receive.
Single public dataset, no external or prospective validation, and no patient-level demographic analysis: results may not generalise to other hospitals or scanners.
binary_notes: Argmax mapped to pneumonia-vs-not gives sensitivity 98.5% and specificity 60.7% on NORMAL/PNEUMONIA images (6 pneumonia missed, 92 normal flagged).
0 NORMAL/PNEUMONIA test images were predicted as COVID by argmax; in the binary view these count as 'not pneumonia'.
A threshold of 0.59 on P(PNEUMONIA), chosen on validation data, gives test sensitivity 98.5% and specificity 65.0%. It is an analysis only and is not used in production.

Validation for threshold selection is the 20% hold-out from dataset/train (NORMAL=248, PNEUMONIA=787); it comes from the same source distribution as training and was also used for checkpoint selection.
